basic_details.job_title: DCCM Perambalur Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: District Climate Change Mission Perambalur (DCCM Perambalur) has notified 1 vacancy for the Technical Assistant post on a contract basis for a period of 19 months under advertisement number 4384/2022/P2. Eligible candidates who are residents of Perambalur District and possess an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences / Environmental Sciences / Ecology / Forestry / Wildlife / Public Policy / Similar / allied fields along with basic typing skills in Tamil and English can apply. Applicants must download and completely fill out the application form, then submit it by e-mail or by post on or before

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Candidates should possess an Undergraduate Degree in any one of the following fields: Life Sciences / Environmental Sciences / Ecology / Forestry / Wildlife / Public Policy / Similar / allied fields. Additionally, candidates must possess basic typing skills in both Tamil and English. | Experience: Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience will be given priority. | Age Limit: The applicant must not have completed 40 years of age as on 26.10.2026. | Residence Requirement: The candidate must be a resident of Perambalur District.

selection_process: The notification specifies that applications are invited from eligible candidates
but does not detail further steps of a formal written examination or interview stages beyond document verification and evaluation of qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Technical Assistant post permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The post is on a contractual basis for a period of 19 months.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must not have completed 40 years of age as on 26.10.2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is required for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 26.10.2026 by 5.00 p.m.
